lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੀ ਭੂਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਗੁ ਜੋਹੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: laagee bhookh maaiaa mag johai mukat padaarath mohi khare ||3||
lines.translation: Driven by hunger, it sees the path of Maya's riches; this emotional attachment takes away the treasure of liberation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਢੂਢਤ ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan palaav kare nahee paavai it ut dhoodhat thaak pare ||
lines.translation: Weeping and wailing, he does not receive them; he searches here and there, and grows weary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਕੂੜ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar viaape kooR kuta(n)b siu preet kare ||4||
lines.translation: Engrossed in sexual desire, anger and egotism, he falls in love with his false relatives. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਵੈ ਭੋਗੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕਾਲ ਘਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaavai bhogai sun sun dekhai pahir dikhaavai kaal ghare ||
lines.translation: He eats and enjoys, listens and watches, and dresses up to show off in this house of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਕਾਲੁ ਟਰੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin gurasabad na aap pachhaanai bin har naam na kaal tare ||5||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not undersand himself. Without the Lord's Name, death cannot be avoided. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਛੀਨਿ ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetaa mohu haumai kar bhoole meree meree karate chheen khare ||
lines.translation: The more attachment and egotism delude and confuse him, the more he cries out, "Mine, mine!", and the more he loses out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਸਹਸੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: tan dhan binasai sahasai sahasaa phir pachhutaavai mukh dhoor pare ||6||
lines.translation: His body and wealth pass away, and he is torn by skepticism and cynicism; in the end, he regrets and repents, when the dust falls on his face. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖਿਸਿਆ ਕਫੁ ਕੰਠੁ ਬਿਰੂਧੋ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਢਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: biradh bhaiaa joban tan khisiaa kaph ka(n)th biroodho nainahu neer dhare ||
lines.translation: He grows old, his body and youth waste away, and his throat is plugged with mucous; water flows from his eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਰਹੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਪਣ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਾਕਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: charan rahe kar ka(n)pan laage saakat raam na ridai hare ||7||
lines.translation: He feet fail him, and his hands shake and tremble; the faithless cynic does not enshrine the Lord in his heart. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਈ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਰਖਿਓ ਘਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat gaee kaalee hoo dhaule kisai na bhaavai rakhio ghare ||
lines.translation: His intellect fails him, his black hair turns white, and no one wants to keep him in their home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮ ਐਸੇ ਦੋਖ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ਨਰਕਿ ਖਰੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: bisarat naam aise dokh laagahi jam maar samaare narak khare ||8||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, these are the stigmas which stick to him; the Messenger of Death beats him, and drags him to hell. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab janam ko lekh na mitaee janam marai kaa kau dos dhare ||
lines.translation: The record of one's past actions cannot be erased; who else is to blame for one's birth and death?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur baad jeevan hor maranaa bin gurasabadai janam jare ||9||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, life and death are pointless; without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, life just burns away. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰ ਭਏ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਫੋਕਟ ਕਰਮ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khusee khuaar bhae ras bhogan phokat karam vikaar kare ||
lines.translation: The pleasures enjoyed in happiness bring ruin; acting in corruption is useless indulgence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੂਲੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਪਰੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar lobh mool khoio sir dharam raai kaa da(n)d pare ||10||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, and caught by greed, he betrays his own source; the club of the Righteous Judge of Dharma will strike him over the head. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh raam naam gun gaavahi jaa kau har prabh nadar kare ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name; the Lord God blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: te niramal purakh apara(n)par poore te jag mahi gur govi(n)d hare ||11||
lines.translation: Those beings are pure, perfect unlimited and infinite; in this world, they are the embodiment of the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har simarahu gur bachan samaarahu sa(n)gat har jan bhaau kare ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord; meditate and contemplate the Guru's Word, and love to associate with the humble servants of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧੨॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: har jan gur paradhaan duaarai naanak tin jan kee ren hare ||12||8||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servants are the embodiment of the Guru; they are supreme and respected in the Court of the Lord. Nanak seeks the dust of the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||12||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਕਾਫੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo kaaphee mahalaa 1 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Kaafee, First Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਉ ਵੰਞਉ ਡੁੰਮਣੀ ਕਿਤੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavau va(n)njau du(n)manee kitee mitr kareu ||
lines.translation: The double-minded person comes and goes, and has numerous friends.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਵਾਢੀ ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੇਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan dhoee na lahai vaadhee kiu dheereu ||1||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is separated from her Lord, and she has no place of rest; how can she be comforted? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਡਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪਿਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maidaa man rataa aapanaRe pir naal ||
lines.translation: My mind is attuned to the Love of my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਕੀਤੀ ਹਿਕ ਭੋਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau ghol ghumaaee kha(n)neeai keetee hik bhoree nadar nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to the Lord; if only He would bless me with His Glance of Grace, even for an instant! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeeaRai dohaaganee saahuraRai kiu jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a rejected bride, abandoned in my parents' home; how can I go to my in-laws now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mai gal augan muthaRee bin pir jhoor maraau ||2||
lines.translation: I wear my faults around my neck; without my Husband Lord, I am grieving, and wasting away to death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeeaRai pir sa(n)malaa saahuraRai ghar vaas ||
lines.translation: But if, in my parents' home, I remember my Husband Lord, then I will come to dwell in the home of my in-laws yet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵੰਧਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sava(n)dh sohaaganee pir paaiaa gunataas ||3||
lines.translation: The happy soul-brides sleep in peace; they find their Husband Lord, the treasure of virtue. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਫੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੀ ਪਟ ਕੀ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: leph nihaalee pat kee kaapaR a(n)g banaai ||
lines.translation: Their blankets and mattresses are made of silk, and so are the clothes on their bodies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਮੁਤੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਡੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: pir mutee dohaaganee tin dukhee rain vihaai ||4||
lines.translation: The Lord rejects the impure soul-brides. Their life-night passes in misery. ||4||
